qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Entrenched local distribution concessions (electricity and gas), district heating grids, and waste-to-energy assets in Milan, Brescia, and Lombardy create local infrastructure monopolies. Operating tangible ROIC exceeds 16-20% due to local concession scale, though regulatory returns are capped by ARERA.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance sheet leverage & capex dilution, REJECT). Lombardy multi-utility with protected local concession networks, but net debt of €4.15B is 5.5x net income (€750M), exceeding the 4.0x ceiling. Heavy continuous capex (€1.68B vs €955M D&A) depresses multi-year free cash flow conversion to ~69%, requiring persistent debt reliance.
qualitative.evidence: FY2022-2025 net income averaged ~€670M while capex expanded from €1.24B to €1.68B annually, generating negative pure free cash flow in FY2023 and FY2024. Long-term debt stands at €6.03B against €1.88B cash, yielding net debt / net income of 5.5x. Regulated tariff cap keeps median GAAP ROIC at ~10%.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
